comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A new Memorial Album, "Fantasy Cruise", this should be introduced in Lost Memories Chapter 2: Colossus. This MA consists of five items:

Memory Traverser's Coat
Great Lighthouse Earrings
Memory Traverser's Hat
Memory Traverser's Boots
Great Lighthouse Axe

They are obtained at random by collecting Paper Fragment with a Tower and Paper Fragment with a Colossus items from the two Sea of Wonders by Alexandria and Candia, then exchanging said items in those two towns with the corresponding SoW NPC.

Once completed, report the MA to Leo Africanus in Tunis and receive your reward:

Silver Pendant

Hope this helps. Cheers.
